name: The Tofu Crossing
prompt: Float a tofu kitchen and a vegetable stall in separate shallow market canals. A cook passes a steaming basket across their shared landing to a grocer arranging green bundles.

name: Market at Low Water
prompt: Build stepped trading banks inside an enclosed tidal demonstration basin. Boats moor at different levels beside a pulley carrying produce up to the permanent street.

name: The Flower Barges
prompt: Fill narrow boats with upright buckets of cut flowers. At a crossing raft, florists pass stems across the water and bind brilliant bouquets beneath a striped sunshade.

name: A Kitchen Between Hulls
prompt: Moor three boats around a floating stove platform in an inland market pool. One provides noodles, another greens, and diners sit at the low rail of the third.

name: The Basket Return
prompt: Make a loop of trading skiffs around a wicker repair island. Full baskets travel toward the landings; empty split baskets pile up beside a weaver replacing their handles.
